articles.title: PHINIA to Participate in Bank of America’s 33rd Annual Industrials, Transportation and Airlines Key Leaders Conference
articles.mainIdea: PHINIA to Participate in Bank of America’s 33rd Annual Industrials, Transportation and Airlines Key Leaders Conference
articles.summary: Business Wire: PHINIA to Participate in Bank of America’s 33rd Annual Industrials, Transportation and Airlines Key Leaders Conference. AUBURN HILLS, Mich., April 29, 2026--PHINIA Inc. (NYSE: PHIN), a leader in premium fuel systems, electrical systems and aftermarket solutions, announced today that it will participate in Bank of America’s 33rd Annual Industrials, Transportation and Airlines Key Leaders Conference on Wednesday, May 13, 2026. Conference participation will be in-person and include a Q&A session to discuss dynamics across the various markets PHINIA serves around the world and the Company’s business. Related tickers mentioned: PHIN.
